headline: 9-month GDP growth highest in 15 years, 12 localities post double-digit growth
summary: Vietnam's third-quarter GDP grew 9.95% year on year, up from 8.49% in the first half. Nine-month growth is estimated at 9.01%, the highest in 15 years, with 12 of 34 localities posting double-digit growth.
why: Vietnam is a fast-growing Southeast Asian export manufacturer, and its GDP pace shapes regional trade, foreign investment and the outlook for its currency and equities.
